complete_source_units.text: My heart poured forth a good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue is the reed of a swiftly writing scribe.
Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one, in your fairness and your beauty,
Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your garments, from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.
All the glory of the king’s daughter is within; she is arrayed in gold-fringed, varied embroidery.
In place of your fathers, sons were born unto you; you will establish them as rulers over all the earth.
Do not fear when a person grows rich and when the glory of his house increases.
For all the forest’s wild animals are Mine, beasts on the mountains and cattle.
My heart was troubled within me, and dread of death fell upon me.
For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured it; and if the one hating me had boasted against me, I would have hidden from him.
All day they detested my words; all their thoughts against me are for evil.
Thou didst guide me, for Thou becamest my hope, a tower of strength before the enemy.
Thou broughtest us into the trap; Thou didst place afflictions upon our back.
Thy processions were seen, God, the processions of my God, the King in the holy place.
For Thou knowest my reproach, shame and embarrassment; all those afflicting me are before Thee.
Add lawlessness to their lawlessness, and let them not enter Thy righteousness.
I became like a portent to the many, and Thou art a mighty helper.
Let the mountains take up peace for Thy people, and the hills in righteousness.
until I enter God’s sanctuary and understand their last things.
All those without understanding in heart were troubled; they slept their sleep, and all the men of wealth found nothing with their hands.
From heaven Thou didst cause judgment to be heard; the earth feared and grew quiet,
I am poor and in toils from my youth; but after being raised up, I was humbled and left helpless.
Come, let us bow down and fall before Him, and let us weep before the Lord who made us.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our lawless deeds,
They give drink to all the beasts of the field; wild donkeys will receive it for their thirst.
A man will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.
I will take the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord.
How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou give me judgment against those who pursue me?
I did not turn away from Thy judgments, for Thou didst instruct me.
I reckoned all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; therefore I loved Thy testimonies continually.
Sixteen: Ain. I did judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those who wrong me.
I opened my mouth and drew breath, for I longed for Thy commandments.
Their storehouses full, pouring forth from this to that; their sheep bearing many young, multiplying in their outgoing places.
Their oxen fat; there is no collapse of a fence and no passage out, nor any cry in their squares.
For He strengthened the bars of your gates; He blessed your children within you.
He sends His oracle to the earth; His word will run swiftly,
young men and young women, old people with younger people.
to execute upon them a written judgment. This is glory for all His holy ones.
